_about: Corrected TUF 5/6 pre-apply simulation evidence after the completeness-matrix exact-verification repair. No canonical season data was applied. The prior BEFORE counts were contaminated because a later professional rematch between the same fighter ids could verify a house bout. Under the repaired verifier, house bouts use only bout-specific commission / applied official repair / same-bout official-network recap evidence; professional finals use only the exact linked finale DB bout. The commission-apply side remains 15/15 verified because those 14 house bouts would then have their own commission evidence.
